title: Immunocytochemical and Immunohistochemical Analysis
author: Marzia Ognibene
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.jtxcnpn

steps.title: Detach and cytospin cells
steps.instruction: Detach cells from culture flasks with trypsin, wash, resuspend in PBS, count, and cytospin onto Polysine™ slides.

steps.title: Fix cells in methanol‑acetone
steps.instruction: Fix cells by immersing slides in methanol‑acetone (1:1) for 15 min at –20 °C, then wash in PBS.

steps.title: Block endogenous peroxidases
steps.instruction: Immerse slides in distilled water containing 3 % H₂O₂ for 15 min, then wash in PBS.

steps.title: Block non‑specific binding
steps.instruction: Incubate slides in 20 % goat serum in PBS‑0.05 % Tween (PBS‑T) for 1 h at 37 °C in a humidified chamber.

steps.title: Primary antibody incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate slides for 2 h at room temperature in a humidified chamber with rabbit or mouse primary antibody diluted in PBS‑T; include negative control slides incubated with PBS‑T alone.

steps.title: Wash slides with PBS
steps.instruction: Wash slides twice with PBS.

steps.title: Secondary antibody incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate slides for 1 h at room temperature in a humidified chamber with biotinylated secondary goat antibody (LSAB2 System‑HRP kit, Dako).

steps.title: Wash slides with PBS
steps.instruction: Wash slides twice with PBS.

steps.title: HRP‑streptavidin incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate slides for 40 min at room temperature in a humidified chamber with HRP‑streptavidin (LSAB2 System‑HRP kit, Dako).

steps.title: Wash slides with PBS
steps.instruction: Wash slides twice with PBS.

steps.title: Develop with DAB
steps.instruction: Develop the reaction with DAB for a few minutes.

steps.title: Counterstain with hematoxylin
steps.instruction: Wash briefly with distilled water, then counterstain with Harris’ hematoxylin for 3 seconds.

steps.title: Final washes
steps.instruction: Wash slides with running water for 10 minutes, then rinse with distilled water.

steps.instruction: Mount coverslips using DPX mounting medium.

steps.title: Fix tissue specimens
steps.instruction: Fix specimens for 24–48 h in 10 % neutral buffered formalin, then embed in paraffin.

steps.title: Deparaffinize tissue sections
steps.instruction: Deparaffinize by immersing sections in xylene twice for 30 min each.

steps.title: Rehydrate tissue sections
steps.instruction: Rehydrate sequentially:

steps.title: Antigen retrieval
steps.instruction: Immerse sections in 0.01 M citrate buffer (pH 6.0) and heat in a microwave oven at 750 W for 15 min.

steps.title: Wash after retrieval
steps.instruction: Wash sections with PBS.

steps.title: Block endogenous peroxidases (tissue)
steps.instruction: Immerse sections in distilled water containing 3 % H₂O₂ for 15 min, then wash with PBS.

steps.title: Block non‑specific binding (tissue)
steps.instruction: Incubate sections in 20 % goat serum in PBS‑0.05 % Tween (PBS‑T) for 1 h at 37 °C in a humidified chamber.

steps.title: Primary antibody incubation (tissue)
steps.instruction: Incubate sections overnight at 4 °C in a humidified chamber with primary antibody; include negative controls with PBS‑T alone.

steps.title: Wash slides with PBS (tissue)
steps.instruction: Wash sections twice with PBS.

steps.title: Secondary antibody incubation (tissue)
steps.instruction: Incubate sections for 1 h at room temperature in a humidified chamber with biotinylated secondary goat antibody (LSAB2 System‑HRP kit, Dako).

steps.title: Wash slides with PBS (tissue)
steps.instruction: Wash sections twice with PBS.

steps.title: HRP‑streptavidin incubation (tissue)
steps.instruction: Incubate sections for 40 min at room temperature in a humidified chamber with HRP‑streptavidin (LSAB2 System‑HRP kit, Dako).

steps.title: Wash slides with PBS (tissue)
steps.instruction: Wash sections twice with PBS.

steps.title: Develop with DAB (tissue)
steps.instruction: Develop the reaction with DAB for a few minutes.

steps.title: Counterstain with hematoxylin (tissue)
steps.instruction: Wash with distilled water, then counterstain with Harris’ hematoxylin for 3 seconds.

steps.title: Final washes (tissue)
steps.instruction: Wash sections with running water for 10 minutes, then rinse with distilled water.

steps.instruction: Dehydrate sequentially:

steps.title: Mount tissue with DPX
steps.instruction: Mount coverslips using DPX mounting medium.
